description: Record investments the user tells you about in their Bluu net worth; Bluu never buys, sells or moves money. Units of a stock, ETF, fund, CDT or crypto they bought, units they sold, a dividend or interest they received, or delete a purchase this chat added, by its `ref`. Fill in exactly ONE. The broker is an account: a purchase is paid from it and a sale pays into it, so the cash left at the broker is that account's balance, never something to record here. Each purchase is its own lot; `wealth` (view=assets) shows the total units and average cost. Every detail must come from the user or from a statement or screenshot they shared — ask for anything missing; never guess a price, a date or an account. Nothing is saved until they approve it with `confirm`. Never approve on their behalf.

buy.description: Units the user bought. Give either unit_price or total_cost.

account.description: The account the money was paid from: the broker ("Trii") or a bank. Required unless the user already owned it before Bluu. If Bluu answers with options, ask which one.

already_owned.description: The user already held this before using Bluu: record it without taking money out of any account. Only when the user says so.

asset.description: The asset as the user names it: its ticker ("NUCO", "VOO") or its name ("Bitcoin", "CDT Bancolombia").

asset_type.description: Only for an asset Bluu does not have yet; Bluu asks when it needs it. If the user did not say it, and a file they shared with you does not show it, ASK them — never guess or fill it in yourself.

country.description: ISO country that issued a CDT or bond, e.g. "CO". If the user did not say it, and a file they shared with you does not show it, ASK them — never guess or fill it in yourself.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code: "USD", "COP", "EUR". If the user did not say it, and a file they shared with you does not show it, ASK them — never guess or fill it in yourself.

fees.description: Commission and fees, added to the cost, as a plain decimal: "38900", "12.50". No symbols or separators. If the user did not say it, and a file they shared with you does not show it, ASK them — never guess or fill it in yourself.

quantity.description: How many units, as a plain decimal: "17", "0.05". If the user did not say it, and a file they shared with you does not show it, ASK them — never guess or fill it in yourself.

total_cost.description: What all the units cost together, before fees, as a plain decimal: "38900", "12.50". No symbols or separators. If the user did not say it, and a file they shared with you does not show it, ASK them — never guess or fill it in yourself.

unit_price.description: The price of ONE unit, as a plain decimal: "38900", "12.50". No symbols or separators. If the user did not say it, and a file they shared with you does not show it, ASK them — never guess or fill it in yourself.

delete.description: Delete a purchase THIS chat added, by its `ref`. Only the user can approve it, with a click.

ref.description: The `ref` Bluu gave on it in a result: only what was added from this chat carries one. Without a `ref`, it was made in Bluu or by another assistant, and is changed there.

dividend.description: A dividend, or the interest a CDT paid: income.

amount.description: How much was paid, as a plain decimal: "38900", "12.50". No symbols or separators. If the user did not say it, and a file they shared with you does not show it, ASK them — never guess or fill it in yourself.

asset.description: The asset as the user names it: its ticker ("NUCO", "VOO") or its name ("Bitcoin", "CDT Bancolombia").

category.description: The category, in the words the user used or one Bluu offered. Never pick one the user did not say: ask. The one exception is a row of a file the user shared: propose one of THEIR categories (`categories` lists them) and show it to them before they say yes. Never one they do not have in Bluu. If Bluu answers with options, offer those.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code: "USD", "COP", "EUR". If the user did not say it, and a file they shared with you does not show it, ASK them — never guess or fill it in yourself.

edit.description: Fix the units, cost or date of a purchase THIS chat added. Done in Bluu for now: Bluu answers with the link.

ref.description: The `ref` Bluu gave on it in a result: only what was added from this chat carries one. Without a `ref`, it was made in Bluu or by another assistant, and is changed there.

sell.description: Units the user sold. Give either unit_price or proceeds.

account.description: The account the money went to: the broker or a bank.

asset.description: The asset as the user names it: its ticker ("NUCO", "VOO") or its name ("Bitcoin", "CDT Bancolombia").

currency.description: ISO 4217 code: "USD", "COP", "EUR". If the user did not say it, and a file they shared with you does not show it, ASK them — never guess or fill it in yourself.

lot.description: YYYY-MM-DD: only when Bluu asks which lot, from the options it gave.

proceeds.description: What the sale brought in, in total, after fees, as a plain decimal: "38900", "12.50". No symbols or separators. If the user did not say it, and a file they shared with you does not show it, ASK them — never guess or fill it in yourself.

quantity.description: Units sold. Omit when the user sold the whole lot. If the user did not say it, and a file they shared with you does not show it, ASK them — never guess or fill it in yourself.

unit_price.description: The price of ONE unit, as a plain decimal: "38900", "12.50". No symbols or separators. If the user did not say it, and a file they shared with you does not show it, ASK them — never guess or fill it in yourself.

space.description: Space name, e.g. "Casa". Omit for the user's personal space.
